text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh look, it's about time for me to go to training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, did you see this, City? You're on the cover!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Gold City, the runner captivating crowds as she bolts across the track, leaving a ray of gold in her wake."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone's talking about your heated race! They say you've gotten so much faster now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So yeah, that happened. Talk about a cringe headline, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They're looking at my running now. And if I can become even faster…
choice_data_list: You'll be featured for an entire issue!
You'll be featured for an entire issue!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh, maybe… Now that you've said it, you've got to make it happen, yeah?
